findings.summary: Permission kinds must be exactly filesystem.read, filesystem.write, network.connect, process.spawn, and secrets.read; renamed hyphenated values are incompatible.

Schema patterns alone accept stale readiness, completion, policy, binding, invocation, change, evidence, attempt, retry, and traceability digests; semantic validator checks must bind canonical material.
RawExecutorResult must bind the exact invocation fingerprint, ExecutionBinding digest, and executor identity/version so substitution or replay under another request fails.
ExecutorInvocation must bind a workspaceBaseDigest, not an unconstrained workspaceBase string.
The approved initial module contract is version 0.1.0; attempt 002 changed it to 1.0.0 without an approved version transition.
